name: tr_gasol
caption:
IF MARC GASOL HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🌯 Munchlax: wolfs down its weight in food every day. The Big Burrito, the 48th pick
🐚 Cloyster: once it slams its shell shut, nobody can open it. 2013 Defensive Player of the Year, the first European to win it
🕊️ Togekiss: shares its blessings with those around it. Traded to us Feb 7, 2019, his passing made us the top 3-point team the rest of the way
🦣 Mamoswine: dug out of ancient ice, it woke up to everyone's amazement. 20 points and 7 boards in his first Finals game ever
🐭 Tandemaus: the pair sticks together no matter what. Marc and Pau, the first brothers to both win NBA titles
🏆 Victini: trainers with it always win. 2019: our first title and a World Cup with Spain, the same year

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

beats.vo: If Marc Gasol had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF MARC GASOL HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Munchlax. It wolfs down its own weight in food every day. They called Marc the Big Burrito, and he went forty-eighth in the draft.
beats.dlg: EATS ITS WEIGHT DAILY.|THE BIG BURRITO, PICK 48

beats.vo: Cloyster. Once it slams its shell shut, nobody can open it. Twenty thirteen: Defensive Player of the Year, the first European to win it.
beats.dlg: ONCE SHUT, IT WON'T OPEN.|2013: FIRST EURO DPOY!

beats.vo: Togekiss. It shares its blessings with those around it. We traded for Marc in February twenty nineteen, and his passing made us the league's best three-point team the rest of the way.
beats.dlg: IT SHARES ITS BLESSINGS.|WE BECAME THE TOP 3PT TEAM

beats.vo: Mamoswine. Dug from ancient ice, it woke up to everyone's amazement. Marc's first Finals game ever: twenty points, seven boards.
beats.dlg: IT WOKE UP FROM THE ICE.|FIRST FINALS GAME: 20 PTS

beats.vo: Tandemaus. The pair sticks together, no matter what. When we won, Marc and Pau became the first brothers to both win NBA titles.
beats.dlg: THE PAIR STICKS TOGETHER.|FIRST BROTHERS WITH RINGS

beats.vo: And the ace. Victini. They say trainers with Victini always win. Twenty nineteen: our first title, and World Cup gold with Spain. Today he's president of the club in Girona.
beats.dlg: ITS TRAINERS ALWAYS WIN.|2019: OUR RING + WORLD CUP

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Gasol: nicknamed The Big Burrito; drafted 48th overall in 2007; 2013 NBA Defensive Player of the Year, the first European to win; traded to Toronto on February 7, 2019 (Feb 7); his pass-first offensive approach helped the Raptors become the NBA's top 3-point shooting team over the second half of the season; 20 points and 7 rebounds in his first ever NBA Finals game; with Pau, the first set of brothers to win NBA titles; won the 2019 NBA title and the 2019 World Cup with Spain the same year; president of Basquet Girona
